content: Wenakakoati Hiye Aimenekotya
Nohinaeharenae, kalaite niraehena hoka waiyekehalaka xomana, xawaiyoretyare Xaotyakiyaho kakoa hoka. Hatya haliti kasetatere xowaka taita atyo halitinai xaotyakiraho xema tyaonita.
Hatya ohiro kaiyanenero atyo exanene kasetatere xowaka haiyanene niraene xema tyaonita. Exanene atyo wainihena hoka maisa atyo haiyanene niraene xema xini tyaohitita.

Exaneniya kasetata hoka xane hatya ena kakoa tyaona hoka iniyalahare nomasehaloiya atyo kaxaokaka. Exaneniya waini hoka xane hatya ena kakoa tyaohitiya hoka ehekore, maisaiya atyo iniyalahare nomasehalo kaxaokakita.

Hiyaiya, nikare atyo xisaonita, nohinaeharenae. Xiso tehitiya atyo koxaka xiwaini Cristo kakoa haxawalita hoka hatyo hiyeta Xaotyakiyaho atyo maisa xoare tyomehetere xomana. Hoka kalikini atyo enomanerenae xisaona. Kaseheta atyo waiye wawenane tyaona maheta Enore koamaniya.
Hoka toahiya wiyahekola ximita wisaonitere xowaka atyo xaotyakiyaho atyo hotikisa womana iniyalahare wiyahekola tyaonitere wiháre hiye hoka hatyo hiyeta wiwaini.

Xakore hoka kalikini atyo maisa Xaotyakiyaho xema xini wisaonita. Hiyaiya, koxaka atyo wiwaini mawaiye nawenanititere wiso ana. Kalikini atyo waiye wisaoheta Enore aokitere akereta wisaona maheta. Enore nisekohare atyo wenati waitare iseheta womana. Hatyo hiyeta maisa atyo toahiyere Xaotyakiyaho exairatyakahare tyaonitere anereheta xini wiso.
Xaotyakiyaho, Iniyalahare Xoaha

Xoare wehenaite? Xaotyakiyaho ala nikare hoka iniyalahare? Maiha nikare xini. Xaotyakiyaho atyo awaiyekehalakatya nomani iniyalahare akiti. Hiyaiya, Xaotyakiyaho atyo nexa: “Awa atyo hatya xiyehare himaiyase hoka haokene homana”, nexa hoka ikoiya awa hatyo hoka maisaiya waiyekehalakita nomani hatyo akiti.
Hoka iniyalahare atyo Xaotyakiyaho hiyeta hoka tyotya xoalini hare nomaiyasetereharenai hotikisa nomani. Hiyaiya, iniyalahare atyo haware tyaonita xaotyakiyaho nonitata hoka maisa xoare tyomita.
Hiyaiya, toahiya Xaotyakiyaho nomásemaniharetatere xowaka waiye ene notyaonita hoka nasemehenere Xaotyakiyaho xowakata iniyalahare aeroretyoa hoka aisa natyo.
Xaotyakiyaho atyo wenati waiyexe isa nomani mahetareta ene hoka axaisakisa natyo.
Hiyaiya, iniyalahare atyo Xaotyakiyaho hiyeta maoseratya natyo hoka hatyo Xaotyakiyaho hiyeta iniyalahare aisa natyo.
Hiyaiya, Xaotyakiyaho atyo aliterexe waiye, exahe iraiti hoka waiyexe kaiserehare.

Nikarala hoka waiyexe hiyeta noxaisaki kaotyaka? Maiha atyo nikare xini! Iniyalahare atyo nikare axomokanikisa natyo. Hiyaiya, iniyalahare atyo waiyexe hiyeta noxaisaki ekaotyakatya nomani. Nikare tyaona iniyalaharaho kahotikisaka maheta. Hatyo hiyeta, xaotyakiyaho hiyeta, iniyalahare exahehare henehare tyaota.
Maisa Notyoma Naokowiterehare Notyomare
Xaotyakiyaho atyo Enore nalitare hoka natyo atyo haliti maiyaterehare. Hiyeta hoka iniyalahare ana nokahalakisaki.
Maisa atyo notyomitereharenae waiyekehalakere nomani. Hiyaiya, maisa atyo notyoma naokowitereharenae xini notyomita, xakore hoka nomaomani naokowiterehare taita atyo notyomita.
Nomaomani naokowiterehare notyomitere hiyeta atyo Xaotyakiyaho notyakekota, exahe aliterexe waiyexe.
Hatyohare hiyeta waiyekehalaka nomani. Maiha atyo natyo xini hatyohare notyomita. Iniyalahare tyaonitere nohiye atyo nikare axomokanikijita natyo.
Hiyaiya, waiyexe atyo maisa tyaonare nohiye. Hatyo atyo nawenani. Waiyexe noxahekoli xakore notyoma naokowita hoka maisa terota hatyoharenae notyomare.
Hiyaiya, maisa atyo waiyexe notyoma naokowitereharenae notyomare xakore hoka nomaomani iniyalahare naokowitereharenae atyo notyomita.
Nomaomani naokowitereharenae atyo notyomehena hoka maisa atyo natyo xini hatyoharenae notyomita. Iniyalahare tyaonita nohiye hoka hatyo atyo nikare axomokanikijita natyo.
Hatyo hiyeta exakerala nawenani tyaonita naoka: notyoma naokowihena xoalini hare waiyexe hoka iniyalahare taita notyomita.
Enore Xaotyakiraho atyo waiyeta nomani, hatyohare kakoa nawaiyoreta.

Xakore hoka hatya xaotyakiye hawareharexe atyo heko aiyateretyoita noxahiti, waiyexe notyoma naokowitereharenae maisa notyoma aokare hoka. Hatyo hiyeta atyo iniyalahare tyaonitere noháre hiye wakanehare notyaonita.
Natyo atyo haliti maihalaharenehare. Xalaite iyehetehena natyo exe nomawenekoaretyakaho nonitata?

Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo ite iyehetehena natyo, hatyo hiyeta nihalahareta Enore kakoa. Hiyeta hoka exakerexe tyaonita nawenani: noxahekoli hiye hoka Enore xaotyakiraho notyaonita, xakore hoka iniyalahare xaotyakiye xema kaisere atyo notyaonita.
